# Yang--Mills frontier audit

Highest proved physics consequence: a finite, local derivative/convexity
budget for one SU(2) heat-kernel plaquette action, plus a tail for the
standalone heat-kernel law.

Not proved:

- that an interacting four-dimensional plaquette marginal equals or is
  dominated by the standalone law;
- dependent large-field or polymer control;
- a gauge-covariant repeated RG map;
- topology-sector uniformity;
- continuum existence, Osterwalder--Schrader reconstruction, confinement, or
  a mass gap.

Title, abstract, applications, discussion, and conclusion respect this
frontier. There is no Clay-problem claim.
